pre: Bag's empty. Keep it that way for about four seconds.
Doors are open. Hunters are not far behind.
Beacon opens at 20. What you do with that is your problem.
Cubes are heavier than they look.
I don't care how much you carry. I care how much you bring back.
Listen for the heat. It only goes one way.
New map. Same rules. Don't get cute.
Green is small money. Gold is the reason we're here.
pre_cautious: Rough few runs. Take the first beacon and breathe.
A small bag is a fine start. We build from there.
You're losing bags. I'm giving you a few extra seconds before they show up.
Nobody ever lost money by leaving early. Just saying.
pre_greedy: You like it hot. So do they.
You keep staying. I noticed. So did the Sniper.
Long stays pay well. They also end badly. Your call.
I've moved a Sniper up for you. You're welcome.
pre_bored: You are getting out too clean. Gold pays more this time. Stay a bit longer.
Every run, same exit time. Try being late once.
Safe is fine. Safe is also a smaller number.
pre_streak: Day {n} on the contract. Don't break it for a cube.
{n} days in a row. The hunters are starting to take it personally.
Streak: {n}. It's only worth something if you keep it.
extract: That's a good bag. Don't let it go to your head.
Made it. Barely, but that counts.
They'll be angry about that one.
extract_greedy: That's the stay I was talking about. Nice.
You waited, you got paid. Remember how that felt.
extract_low: Out with almost nothing. I'll allow it.
A light bag still counts. Barely.
You left money on the floor.
extract_hurt: One hit left. You like it close.
You are bleeding on my floor. Fine, you made it.
That was 1 HP. Don't tell me you planned it.
death_drone: Out-run by a drone. With a full bag that is no surprise.
Chased down by the cheapest thing on the map.
They're fast. Your bag is slow. That's the whole game.
Too many cubes, too few exits.
death_brute: The Brute hits hard and you let it close. Learn the pattern.
Don't stand next to the big one.
Heavy bag, heavy hitter. Bad pairing.
death_sniper: You saw the laser. You walked into it anyway.
Move on the red line, not after it.
That Sniper is still out there. Bounty x2 on Snipers tomorrow.
death_any: You lost it. Remember what you were thinking right before.
Everyone loses a bag. Better now than with a big one.
grudge: That {type} is still out there. Bounty x2 today.
Yesterday's {type} has a crown now. Go collect.
The {type} that got you is marked. Double bounty.
courier_sealed: Crate's sealed. Courier brings it at midnight.
Something's coming tomorrow. Don't miss it.
Courier's on the way. Come back and open it.
courier_open: Crate's open. Dash and one insured slot. Use them.
Told you. Dash is yours, plus a safety net for one cube.
contract_done: Contract done. Cash is in your account.
Daily cleared. Smoke gadget is yours now.
no_upgrade: You're sitting on cash. Go buy something.
